## What's Changed

- **Mixes, radios and "For you" only play what belongs.** Songs come from your own artists and from
  artists those artists are connected to — no more random uploads from an unrelated act with a
  similar name, no slowed/sped-up re-uploads, covers or karaoke, and never the same recording twice.
- **The discovery slider means something now.** Turn it down and a mix stays close to the artists
  you know; at 0 it adds nobody new. Turn it up and new artists are the ones your artists' own
  pages point at.
- **A mix can no longer feed itself.** Listening to songs a mix picked for you still counts in your
  week, but it does not make the next mix chase the same song — only your own choices do.
- **You can push back.** The song menu now has **Less like this** and **Don't recommend this song**,
  and both can be undone from the same row.
- **Mixes stay varied.** Artists are spread apart, songs you keep skipping rest, and two mixes made
  from the same taste are never quite the same.
